runtime_architecture_reconciliations.firewall_profile_semantics: Rule creation specifies -Profile Any, providing comprehensive profile coverage. Step 3 validates as a mandatory precondition that all three individual profiles (Domain, Private, Public) exist and are enabled (Enabled == True).

step_ordering_reconciliation.step_1: Elevation Check (Verifying Administrative Elevation via WindowsPrincipal)
step_ordering_reconciliation.step_2: Pre-Execution Boundary Hash Verification (Comparing to frozen constants)
step_ordering_reconciliation.step_3: Process & Firewall Environment Inspection (Process inspection + mpssvc service query + 3 profile status check)

runtime_architecture_reconciliations.post_execution_hash_semantics: Post-execution boundary hash verification verifies file integrity post-facto. It alerts and records failure if any watched file changed during run; it cannot prevent an already completed execution.
runtime_architecture_reconciliations.historical_store_provenance: Current operational closure validates runtime offline controls and contemporary reproducibility. It does not certify historical store provenance; historical provenance remains subject to the existing database incident disclosure.

execution_attempt_reconciliation.prior_attempt_result: OPERATIONAL_FAILURE at Step 1 (non-elevated token in agent facility)
